description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for interacting with a database of parameters, including loading data models, retrieving parameter info, and handling wildcards. It appears to be part of a larger system managing configuration or device parameters.

methods.name: initNumEntityParamList
methods.description: Loads the parameter count query string into memory.

methods.name: loadDataModel
methods.description: Loads the data model into memory.

methods.name: isWildCardParam
methods.description: Checks if a parameter name contains wildcard characters.

methods.name: getDataModelHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the data model.

methods.name: checkDataModelStatus
methods.description: Checks the current status of the data model.

methods.name: freeDataModelParam
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a DataModelParam structure.

methods.name: getChildParamNamesFromDataModel
methods.description: Retrieves child parameter names and data types given a parameter with wildcards.

methods.name: getParamInfoFromDataModel
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific parameter from the data model.

methods.name: get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Retrieves the complete list of parameters and their count.

methods.name: isParamEndsWithInstance
methods.description: Checks if a parameter name ends with an instance number (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: getNumberOfDigitsInInstanceNumber
methods.description: Gets the number of digits in an instance number within a parameter name (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: getNumberofInstances
methods.description: Gets the number of instances in a parameter name (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: checkMatchingParameter
methods.description: Checks if an attribute value matches a parameter name pattern (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: replaceWithInstanceNumber
methods.description: Replaces part of a parameter name with an instance number (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: appendNextObject
methods.description: Appends the next object to a parameter path (GTEST_ENABLE).

methods.name: test_get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Test function for retrieving the complete parameter list (GTEST_ENABLE).
